parameters.content:
## Enrich
App → this webhook with up to 8 companies.
Runs three actors: `apify/website-content-crawler` (max ±6 pages per site), `vdrmota/contact-info-scraper` (e-mails, phones, social links) and `apify/google-search-scraper` (2 signal queries per company).
The evidence goes back per company; the Claude Qualifier scores it in the app.
